crossRefs.note: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my…
I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.
But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God…
who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still…
You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it…
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…

translations.web: They came to him, and awoke him, saying, “Master, master, we are dying!” He awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water, and they ceased, and it was calm.
translations.bsb: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Master, Master, we are perishing!” Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters, and they subsided, and all was calm.
translations.kjv: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
translations.asv: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. And he awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
